Subject: Acme POC: Redwood trial integration plan and checklist

Hi David / Sara —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. As promised, here’s a concise recap of the proposed POC/trial scope and the initial integration checklist so your eng team can assess effort and timelines. I attached a one-page checklist + an integration diagram.

High-level POC goals / success criteria (as discussed):
- End-to-end demo with Acme internal data (sanitized) flowing through Redwood API to generate customer support summaries.
- Latency: 95th percentile response under 600ms for single-turn summaries at 2 concurrent requests per second (SLO).
- Throughput: sustain 200 reqs/min for batch ingestion test without errors.
- Cost: token cost estimate and suggested batching settings in the checklist.
- Quality: summaries match or exceed current baseline on a 5-item prompt test set (we’ll provide evaluation harness).

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Share sandbox credentials + integration guide (we’ll provide SDK samples).
- Week 1: Basic integration (API call + streaming) + run sample prompts.
- Week 2: Tool-calling integration (if you want to call internal KB/HTTP tools) + run evaluation harness.
- Week 3: Final validation, compare against success criteria, and review results with stakeholders.

Integration ownership and next steps:
- Redwood: Marissa (PM) and Dylan (SE) will own technical onboarding and support.
- Acme: David (sales sponsor) and Sara (eng lead) will own data access and test set.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf, integration-diagram.png, demo credentials txt (rdw-acme-demo-credentials.txt).

Can you confirm the timeline looks good and whether you want function/tool-calling included in the initial two-week scope? If yes, we’ll prioritize that in the Week 1 plan.

I’ve also added a Calendly link for a 30-min kickoff if you want to start next Monday: https://calendly.com/marissa/redwood-acme-kickoff

Thanks —

Hi all — following up with the technical integration plan and concrete API/SDK notes for your eng team. I attached an integration diagram and the checklist. Key items below.

1) SDK & API routes (Node & Python samples in the Drive link):
- REST generation: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  - body: {model, prompt, max_tokens, temperature, stop}
- Streaming: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true
  - SSE / chunked responses; each chunk contains partial tokens and metadata (token_index, total_tokens)
- Tool/function calling: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call_tool
  - schema: {tool_name, input: {}} — Redwood will return structured JSON result to the client when a tool is invoked.
- Embeddings: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings

2) Auth & credentials:
- Use API keys scoped to "poc-acme" which we will provision (rdw-acme-demo-credentials.txt attached).
- For private data, recommend using per-request metadata headers (x-acme-object-id) and pinning requests to our dedicated trial region (us-west-2) to avoid cross-region transit.

3) Streaming considerations & UI integration:
- Our streaming supports token-level deltas. We provide an event type field ("message", "tool_call_start", "tool_call_result", "done"). For function/tool calling, you’ll see a "tool_call_start" event followed by "tool_call_result" with JSON payload.

4) Security & compliance:
- SOC 2: we’ll share the attestation PDF; for the POC we can provide redacted evidence and a short answers doc. Logs and audit exports are available via the console (retention configurable).

5) Suggested POC timeline (technical):
- Day 0-2: credentials + basic calls (generate + embeddings)
- Day 3-6: implement streaming in UI + tool calling flow (point to staging KB)
- Day 7-10: run automated evaluation harness (we’ll supply a script) and iterate on prompt templates

6) Acceptance criteria (tech):
- Successful generation using streaming with function-calling in staging (sample run < 2 mins to set up)
- 95th pct latency under 600ms in local perf tests
- No auth/permission gaps; audit logs visible in console

7) Owners:
- Redwood SE: Dylan Brooks (dylan.brooks@redwood.ai) — integration help
- Redwood PM: Marissa Cole — POC coordination and acceptance criteria
- Acme Eng: Sara Khan (sara.khan@acme.com) — implementation owner

Code snippet example (Node, simplified):
- const res = await client.generate({ model: 'rdw-1.2', prompt: 'Summarize...', stream: true });
- client.on('data', chunk => { if (chunk.event === 'tool_call_start') { /* show UI */ } });

If this looks right I’ll open a staging project for you and share the API key. Also, note the batching suggestions in the checklist to control token costs.

Dylan
